newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money little changed at 3.08/3.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money little changed at 3.08/3.10 pct.

text.p: German call money was trading unchanged at 3.08/3.10 percent on Thursday in quiet trade.

Dealers said the Bundesbank's net injection of an additional 1.7 billion marks at Wednesday's repo allocation was sufficient to calm the market but not enough to cause call money rates to fall, dealers said.

Commercial banks' effective deposits totalled 40.2 billion marks on Wednesday, up from 38.3 billion marks on Tuesday. The daily average for the month through Wednesday totalled 39.7 billion marks, up from 39.6 billion.
Lombard borrowings came to about 100 million marks. The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was calculated at 3.12033 percent compared with 3.12333 percent.
